original_ai_output.title_zh: 11名加纳人在尼日利亚获救，此前因签证骗局每人支付4万塞地
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州警方称，11名加纳公民（7男4女）在奥贡州萨加穆被解救，据称他们被以加拿大和西班牙签证为诱饵骗至尼日利亚后遭扣押。警方反绑架部门根据情报采取行动实施解救。该消息由警方发言人于2026年10月20日发布的声明披露，目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚奥贡州警方解救了11名加纳公民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ogun State Police Command in Nigeria has rescued 11 Ghanaian nationals allegedly held hostage in Sagamu

key_facts.fact: 获救者包括7名男性和4名女性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the victims, comprising seven males and four females, were rescued by operatives of the Anti-Kidnapping Unit

key_facts.fact: 这些加纳人据称被以加拿大和西班牙签证为诱饵骗至尼日利亚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: after they were lured to the country with promises of Canadian and Spanish visas

key_facts.fact: 每人据称支付了4万加纳塞地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 11 Ghanaians rescued in Nigeria after paying GH¢40,000 each over visa scam

key_facts.fact: 警方声明由发言人于2026年10月20日发布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in a statement issued on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, by its Police Public Relations Officer, Mr Oluseyi Babaseyi

uncertainties: 被扣押及签证骗局情节为警方声称，尚未经独立核实
目前仅单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
